answer: With a Code contribution accepted by the project lead backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The design treats each contribution as a garden: small alone, decisive in aggregate. From the trellis to the canyon, the same rule holds: no review, no trust, no exception.
